description.en: Cross-device phone for DeepSeek Harness: dialer, WebRTC voice, SMS relay, RCS group chat with trust gates, and L0–L4 trust verification. Experimental: trust summaries are not a security guarantee.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 跨设备电话：拨号、WebRTC 语音、短信中继、带信任门槛的 RCS 群聊、L0–L4 信任等级核验。实验性：信任摘要非安全保证。
